notes.title: Chicken Cannon is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
My first ever public project has been released, and you're gonna hate me for creating this after you try it!

Nobody was able to beat this game during development...
Get it now and try to be the first person to beat it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41064627/9a79f7b3fc8444e81b09f890aff10218b442a2f4.gif
Buy Chicken Cannon now, and get ready to get angry!
